## TerraDrill: The Power of Azumilium

TerraDrill revolutionizes how you interact with the Minecraft terrain. Say goodbye to conventional pickaxes and master the technology of high-performance drills! By using the rare Azumilium, you can craft energy cores capable of powering devastating industrial tools.

### The Heart of Technology: The Energy Core
Everything starts with the Energy Core. By combining advanced materials with the power of Azumilium, you create the essential fuel source to keep your drills running. As long as the core is in your inventory, your TerraDrill will automatically repair itself, ensuring you never have to stop your excavation.

### Industrial Progression: From Iron to Netherite
The mod offers a complete progression line that follows your journey through the game:

Iron TerraDrill: The beginning of your industrial journey. Faster than a common pickaxe, but still basic.

Gold and Diamond TerraDrills: A significant increase in mining speed and durability.

Netherite TerraDrill: The pinnacle of engineering. An indestructible tool capable of tearing through the toughest materials in the game with ease.

![basic](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59782ddf062921c8ba3eeb1b843bcef062dfdaa5.png)

### Special Abilities and Evolution
It is not just about speed. Every TerraDrill features unique capabilities that can be unlocked through new recipes and upgrades:

Evolution Recipes: Upgrade your drill as you acquire rarer materials.

Special Abilities: Certain versions allow for large-area mining (like 3x3) or feature thermal efficiency to process ores instantly.

![PLUS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4518d49d24661f9e167004fb391da2db08ae4d11.png)

### How to get started?

Mine Azumilium to craft your first Energy Core.

Combine the Core with steel parts and iron tools to assemble your first TerraDrill.

Keep the Core charged in your inventory to never run out of durability!
